value.account:
CHANGED. State: RunState.result_persistence_profile (optional, omitted when None, validated at construction/from_dict/StateManager.initialize; ValueError mentions the profile; load never writes). Selection: orchestrator run and `resume --force-restart` (.orc) pass derived_pure_replay.v1 to initialize; the force-restart branch no longer writes observability onto the source run (it is recorded on the new root), so the source stays byte-identical. calls.py selects it for fresh, non-iterative (step_name_override is None) child frames whose callee bundle has provenance.frontend_kind == 'workflow_lisp'; _CallFrameStateManager validates the existing frame (ValueError 'existing call-frame state ...') before mkdir/writes and never backfills; load_existing_call_frame_read_only added. New modules in orchestrator/workflow: pure_result_replay_errors/_documents/_index/_progress/_runtime/_audit, a pure_result_replay facade (all acceptance names incl. _propagate_pure_ineligibility) and pure_replay_execution (executor wiring). Index: eligible = pure_projection not loop-owned, not on a control-flow SCC, body region, no publishes/consumes; typed addresses are derived from the existing BoundAddress classes; binding documents are walked against the payload binding types (exact refs only, union inactive members type-checked, malformed ref/unbound '${' text/cross-frame refs/cycles/duplicate or mismatched projection identity -> dependency_index_invalid). Shell + classify_pure_replay_progress + StateManager/_CallFrameStateManager begin/reuse/settle transactions; OutcomeRecorder.persist_step_result(eligible_pure_settlement=) keeps the full result in memory, persists the shell, emits the shell to the summary emitter. Executor: pure steps under the profile run derive_only (no bundle read/write, no publish), begin/reuse their single visit via the state manager; resume audits conflicts (raised, no state write) and progress before the prologue, validates leaves and replays the required prefix into the in-memory state after the default-resume decision, failing closed with pure_result_replay_unavailable + context.reason/cause; the restart node is determined once and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=); the provider observation manager is created at execute() start and closed once. Checkpoints: emit_runtime_shadow_record skips eligible points, capture_restore_payload omits bindings sourced from eligible pure steps, default resume filters eligible points before nearest selection and admits VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY only with the profile, progress and bound-input witnesses (else FAIL_CLOSED prior_boundary_not_restorable). Docs: new section in specs/state.md. Tests: tests/test_pure_result_replay.py (78 behavioural tests incl. CLI run/force-restart, interrupted resume with no repeated effects, frame-entry replay, each fail-closed reason, conflicts, union rows, call-frame selection) and two tests in tests/test_provider_observation_workflow.py updated to the new manager-lifetime contract. Full suite: 138 failures, identical to the pre-change baseline (environmental: sockets/tmux/nanobragg/etc.); no new failures.

ALTERNATIVES. Putting all profile logic inside executor.py (rejected: 12k lines already) -> free functions in pure_replay_execution. Recording pure values in a side file or hashing them (rejected: contradicts the value-free shell). Making _determine_resume_default_resume_decision take restart_node_id as a kwarg (rejected: existing tests patch it with a (state) signature) -> the executor stashes the boundary in _resume_restart_node_id and the wrapper forwards it to the planner. Computing 'required' pure nodes from a precise use-def of every node kind (rejected as too large) -> a structural scan of later nodes for typed addresses and root.steps.<key>. strings, which can over-approximate (extra replay) but not under-approximate for typed addresses.

NOT COVERED / RISKS. The spec leaves several shapes open and I guessed: replay_node calls evaluate_node(node, overlay_state) and expects a step-result mapping; PureReplayBinding.path is (binding_name, *document_path); audit_persisted_surfaces calls resolve_bundle_path(node_ref) with a str subclass carrying node_id/step_id/presentation_key; _propagate_pure_ineligibility is a conservative region helper. Finalization-region pure nodes and nodes with publishes/consumes are treated as ineligible. A failed eligible pure step is terminal under the profile (resume reports progress_witness_invalid instead of re-running as visit two); guard-skipped eligible steps keep a visit-less skipped row, which the classifier accepts only when the row also has no visit_count. Mixed-source restore bindings are still captured (with values from the overlay); only bindings whose source step is an eligible pure node are omitted. Iteration-owned child frames are recognised by step_name_override, which is how the loop path calls execute_call. No test covers a union pure node through a full resume, a recurrent pure node inside a profiled run, nested call-frame resume with the profile, or the 'durable intrinsic wrong type' reason end-to-end (the logic exists in _validate_leaf). Not committed.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 persistence profile (value-free pure completion shells, in-memory replay on resume, profile selection for run/force-restart/Workflow Lisp child frames, checkpoint filtering and frame-entry default resume) with spec text and 78 new tests.
